StreetBite Fest | Good Food. Great Company.

Prompt

Create a bold, energetic landing page for a weekend food truck festival called "StreetBite Fest" held in a waterfront park in Portland, OR. The page should feel fun, vibrant, and community-driven — celebrating street food culture. It runs every summer on the last weekend of July.

1. NAVIGATION BAR
- Logo: "StreetBite Fest" in a playful condensed font with a taco icon baked into the "B"
- Links: Lineup, Map, Schedule, Tickets, Sponsors, FAQ
- Right side: "Get Tickets" CTA (solid #E11D48 rose), date badge "Jul 25–27, 2026"
- White background, sticky on scroll with shadow
- Mobile: hamburger with full-screen overlay on bright yellow (#FEF08A) background

2. HERO SECTION
- Full-width photo collage background: close-ups of sizzling tacos, loaded fries, colorful food trucks with string lights at dusk
- Center-aligned overlay:
  - Eyebrow badge: "3rd Annual"
  - Headline: "Portland's Biggest Street Food Party"
  - Subheadline: "50+ food trucks · 3 stages of live music · craft cocktails · waterfront vibes"
  - Date and location: "July 25–27, 2026 · Tom McCall Waterfront Park"
  - Two CTAs: "Get Tickets" (solid rose #E11D48) + "See the Lineup" (outline white)
- Animated confetti or sparkle particles floating subtly over the hero
- Bottom edge: wavy SVG divider in white

3. THE LINEUP (vendor grid)
- Section headline: "50+ Trucks. Zero Bad Bites."
- Filter bar with cuisine tags: All, Mexican, Asian, BBQ, Vegan, Seafood, Desserts, Fusion, Mediterranean
- 4-column card grid (3 on tablet, 2 on mobile):
  - "Taco Libre" — Mexican — "Wood-fired birria tacos, elote, churros" — 📍Zone A — photo of birria tacos — Badge: "Fan Favorite"
  - "Bao Down" — Asian Fusion — "Steamed bao buns, kimchi fries, matcha soft serve" — 📍Zone B — photo of bao buns
  - "Holy Smoke BBQ" — BBQ — "14-hour brisket, pulled pork mac & cheese, cornbread" — 📍Zone A — photo of brisket plate — Badge: "New This Year"
  - "Green Machine" — Vegan — "Jackfruit sliders, cauliflower wings, açaí bowls" — 📍Zone C — photo of jackfruit slider
  - "Catch of the Day" — Seafood — "Lobster rolls, fish & chips, clam chowder bowls" — 📍Zone B — photo of lobster roll
  - "Sugar Rush" — Desserts — "Mini donuts, rolled ice cream, churro sundaes" — 📍Zone C — photo of rolled ice cream
  - "Naan Stop" — Mediterranean — "Lamb shawarma wraps, falafel plates, halloumi fries" — 📍Zone A — photo of shawarma
  - "Umami Lab" — Fusion — "Ramen burgers, Korean corn dogs, miso caramel popcorn" — 📍Zone B — photo of ramen burger — Badge: "Must Try"
- Each card: truck photo, cuisine badge, name, description, zone tag, hover scale-up effect
- "View All 50+ Trucks →" link at bottom
- Background: #FEF2F2 (warm rose tint)

9. FAQ ACCORDION
- Section headline: "Good Questions"
- 8 expandable questions:
  - "Can I bring my dog?" — "Yes! StreetBite Fest is dog-friendly. Please keep dogs leashed and clean up after them. Water stations are available in each zone."
  - "Is there parking?" — "Limited street parking available. We recommend biking, MAX Light Rail (Yamhill District stop), or rideshare. Bike valet is free!"
  - "Can I use cards or is it cash only?" — "All trucks accept cards and mobile pay. A few also take cash. Two ATMs are on-site."
  - "Are there vegetarian/vegan options?" — "Absolutely! Zone C features dedicated vegan trucks, and most other trucks have at least one plant-based option. Look for the green leaf icon."
  - "What if it rains?" — "Rain or shine! This is Portland, after all. Covered seating is available in the VIP and Beer Garden areas. We recommend layers."
  - "Can I buy tickets at the door?" — "Yes, if not sold out. Door prices are $5 more per tier. We strongly recommend buying online."
  - "Is the festival accessible?" — "Yes. All pathways are ADA accessible. Accessible parking and restrooms available. Contact us for specific accommodation needs."
  - "What are the age restrictions?" — "All ages welcome! Kids under 10 are free. The Beer & Cocktail Garden is 21+ with valid ID."

10. NEWSLETTER & FINAL CTA

- Headline: "Don't Miss a Single Bite"

- Below: large CTA — "See You at the Waterfront" with "Get Tickets" button

11. FOOTER
- 4 columns: Festival, Eat & Drink, Get Involved, Info
- Festival: Schedule, Map, Tickets, FAQ, Past Years
- Eat & Drink: Full Lineup, Cuisine Guide, Beer Garden Menu, Dietary Guide
- Get Involved: Vendor Applications, Sponsor Info, Volunteer, Press Kit

- "© 2026 StreetBite Fest. All rights reserved. A community event by Portland Street Food Collective."

Design: Bold, playful, appetizing. Primary: #E11D48 (rose), secondary: #F97316 (orange), accent: #FEF08A (festival yellow). Backgrounds: white alternating with #FEF2F2 (rose tint), #FEF08A (yellow), and one dark #1C1917 section. Typography: Bricolage Grotesque for headings (bold, playful), Inter for body. Cards with 12px border-radius, generous padding, playful hover animations. Street food photography should be close-up, colorful, and appetizing. Use hand-drawn illustration accents (wavy lines, stars, food doodles) for personality.

Responsive: On mobile, vendor grid becomes 2-column then single column with swipe. Map becomes scrollable/zoomable with a list view toggle. Schedule tabs become swipeable. Ticket cards stack vertically with "Best Value" first. Music cards become horizontal scroll. FAQ stays full-width accordion. Sticky "Get Tickets" bar at bottom on mobile. Navigation collapses to hamburger with yellow background overlay.
